_: The realm's scenes in the world (scenes.gd and scene_kinds/; docs/TUNING.md). fleeing: how many refugees leave a town, by the scene's kind. flight: how far each walks out before he is gone (out, world units) and how long a runner and a trudger take to get there (run_s, trudge_s; a third run). burn: a sacked or razed town's fire, [seconds, size]. convoy: the King's grain, gold or ward on the road (scene_kinds/convoy.gd, by the Mover's road): pace (world units a second), min/max (seconds the road takes), escort ([behind the wagon, across] for each of its crown men), hail (seconds they hail the town before the caption fades). rider: the King's rider (scene_kinds/rider.gd): pace, min/max, linger (seconds he stands at the town before the caption fades).
